name: Side-to-Side Leg Swing
steps: Face a wall, place your hands on it for balance and shift your weight onto one leg.
Brace your core lightly and lift your working foot just off the floor.
Swing your working leg smoothly across the front of your standing leg, then sweep it comfortably out to the side in a controlled pendulum motion.
Continue swinging steadily through your comfortable range for the target duration on one leg, then switch sides.
tips: Keep your torso upright and toes pointing mostly forward rather than twisting your lower back aggressively.
Start gently and build amplitude gradually as your hips loosen up.
